PokeG_GreenHouse.title: Stepped green house
PokeG_GreenHouse.drawn: Two of the three green houses with a stepped roof: a block of two storeys two tiles wide and a one-storey wing beside it with the door, green standing-seam roofs, brown panels in dark timber lines, cream window frames, a beam between the storeys.

PokeG_GreenHouseMirrored.title: Stepped green house, mirrored
PokeG_GreenHouseMirrored.drawn: The third stepped green house, drawn mirrored (its wing on the left): a model of its own, the user's choice, since the game turns pieces but cannot mirror them.

PokeG_GreenWideHouse.title: Wide green house
PokeG_GreenWideHouse.drawn: Four copies of the green house with one roof over four tiles: two storeys, two windows in a cream panel upstairs, the door and a window below.

PokeG_DomeCenter.title: Domed centre
PokeG_DomeCenter.drawn: The building in the middle: poke_f's domed centre drawn again with red-brown tiles for its blue panels, the red dome of a Poke Ball (its band and button, as drawn), white walls, purple-blue windows, a glass double door, banded wooden pillars.

PokeG_RedCenter.title: Red centre
PokeG_RedCenter.drawn: The red-roofed building at the bottom middle: a roof of three red sections, a light blue-grey building with rounded white corners, the Poke Ball emblem over a red canopy (as drawn), the glass door, dark grey pillars.

PokeG_Mart.title: Mart
PokeG_Mart.drawn: The shop at the bottom left: a blue slab of a roof with pale dots, the MART sign in front of it (as drawn), light blue-grey walls white at the corners, the glass door and the shop window between dark grey columns.

PokeG_WoodLodge.title: Wooden lodge
PokeG_WoodLodge.drawn: The lodge at the top right: a thick flat roof of planks with a board fascia and a raised part on it, windows of small panes, the door under a porch on two posts.
